description: 30 analysis questions with independently written SQL ground truth. Each item calls one capability and compares its output with SQL over the same entity-level basis (canonical record, non-paper excluded).

questions.question: 全库有多少篇论文？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base

questions.question: CVPR 2025 有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE venue='CVPR' AND year=2025

questions.question: NeurIPS 2024 有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE venue='NeurIPS' AND year=2024

questions.question: 机器学习方法与理论领域有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='ml_foundations'

questions.question: 大语言模型领域有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='llm'

questions.question: 视频超分方向有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE direction_id='cv_lowlevel-d15-video'

questions.question: 智能体领域有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='agents'

questions.question: AI 安全、隐私与公平领域有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='trustworthy_ai'

questions.question: 智能体领域逐年论文数
questions.sql: SELECT year AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='agents' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: 大语言模型领域逐年论文数
questions.sql: SELECT year AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='llm' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: 多模态领域逐年论文数
questions.sql: SELECT year AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='multimodal' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: 智能体与大语言模型总量对比
questions.sql: SELECT 'agents' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='agents' UNION ALL SELECT 'llm', COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='llm'

questions.question: 2024 年智能体与大语言模型数量对比
questions.sql: SELECT 'agents' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='agents' AND year=2024 UNION ALL SELECT 'llm', COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='llm' AND year=2024

questions.question: 全库论文最多的 5 个 venue
questions.sql: SELECT venue AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base GROUP BY venue ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 5

questions.question: 底层视觉领域论文最多的 5 个方向
questions.sql: SELECT direction_id AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='cv_lowlevel' GROUP BY direction_id ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 5

questions.question: 2025 年论文最多的 5 个领域
questions.sql: SELECT area_id AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE year=2025 GROUP BY area_id ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 5

questions.question: AI 安全领域论文最多的 5 个方向
questions.sql: SELECT direction_id AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='trustworthy_ai' GROUP BY direction_id ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 5

questions.question: 大语言模型领域论文最多的 5 个 venue
questions.sql: SELECT venue AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='llm' GROUP BY venue ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 5

questions.question: 领域 × 方向共现最多的 5 对
questions.sql: SELECT area_id AS a, direction_id AS b, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base GROUP BY area_id, direction_id ORDER BY count DESC, a, b LIMIT 5

questions.question: 智能体领域逐年 × 领域共现
questions.sql: SELECT year AS a, area_id AS b, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='agents' GROUP BY year, area_id ORDER BY count DESC, a, b LIMIT 10

questions.question: 方向 × venue 共现最多的 5 对
questions.sql: SELECT direction_id AS a, venue AS b, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base GROUP BY direction_id, venue ORDER BY count DESC, a, b LIMIT 5

questions.question: CVPR 与 ICCV 2025 合计多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE venue IN ('CVPR','ICCV') AND year=2025

questions.question: 2023–2024 年机器学习系统领域多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE area_id='ml_systems' AND year IN (2023,2024)

questions.question: 视频超分方向在 CVPR 有多少篇？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE direction_id='cv_lowlevel-d15-video' AND venue='CVPR'

questions.question: 2024 年标题/摘要中包含 video super-resolution 的论文
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE year=2024 AND (title LIKE '%video super-resolution%' OR abstract LIKE '%video super-resolution%' OR authors LIKE '%video super-resolution%')

questions.question: 视频表示、分割与异常检测方向（cv_understanding-d10）最近 5 篇论文
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE direction_id='cv_understanding-d10'

questions.question: 论文 ape_4046b2a7c63e04d86b0a4ed7 的标题
questions.sql: SELECT title FROM base WHERE entity_id='ape_4046b2a7c63e04d86b0a4ed7'

questions.question: 分类体系包含多少领域与方向？
questions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM area_definitions) AS areas, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direction_definitions) AS directions

questions.question: 大语言模型论文在各 venue 的分布
questions.sql: SELECT venue AS key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM base WHERE area_id='llm' GROUP BY venue ORDER BY count DESC, key LIMIT 20

questions.question: 2026 年有多少篇论文？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE year=2026
